title: Almond Fritter Naan
description: A unique twist on traditional naan, these fritters are filled with ground almonds and spices, inspired by Indian cuisine. Serve warm with a side of chutney or raita.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, ground almonds, yogurt, ghee or oil, cumin seeds, coriander powder, baking powder, and salt. Mix well to form a dough.
Gradually add water and knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Heat a non-stick skillet or tava over medium heat.
Pinch a small ball of dough and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place the disk in the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Flip the fritter and cook for another 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining dough to make more fritters.
Serve warm with a side of chutney or raita.
Note: If the dough becomes too sticky, add a little more flour. If it becomes too dry, add a little more water.
